title: CiMind: Deterministic Epistemic Memory, Sub-5ms Ambient Safety Reflexes, Contemplative Neurobiology Guardrails, and Longitudinal Drift Sentinels for Local-First Cognitive Care Research
description:
Local-first, zero-cloud, cryptographically auditable Python reference kernel (Apache-2.0, standard library only) for aging-in-place and cognitive-impairment (GDS 1–7) smart-home and assistive robotics research (v0.3.0).

Places four deterministic verification seams around untrusted local language models and residential sensors: (1) a 4-zone epistemic memory and code-level corpus firewall preventing patient confabulation, broadcast-media RAG poisoning, cross-bank prompt echoes, and falsified neurochemical claims; (2) pure < 5 ms camera-free fall-fusion, 590 nm circadian pathway, and 868/915 MHz LoRaWAN perimeter safety reflexes; (3) stage-, subtype- (DLB, bvFTD, dysphagia), and mother-tongue-adaptive (L2 → L1) dialogue, contemplative safety envelope (0.1 Hz / secular Kirtan Kriya vs. zero-override hazard blocks), 4-stage somatic crisis grounding & triage, and velocity-capped concierge rules; and (4) 21-day intra-patient Median/MAD longitudinal concordance, interrupted time-series pharmacovigilance (PV-1..PV-7), and 48 h sleep-loss/stupor sentinels.

Non-commercial open-source research scaffold outside EU MDR Regulation (EU) 2017/745 medical-device scope; see LEGAL.md and docs/CLINICAL_AND_SYSTEMS_EVIDENCE_RATIONALE.md.
